def: The two directions of KL divergence between a target P and a model Q: forward KL(P‖Q) pushes Q to cover all of P’s mass, reverse KL(Q‖P) to concentrate on P’s main modes.
practice: Standard distillation on teacher outputs minimizes forward KL; MiniLLM and on-policy distillation use reverse KL, which is also the direction of the usual RLHF KL penalty.
